Cc: support@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime chat errors during tonight's twilight peak

Hi Marissa —

Heads up: between 18:05–18:45 PT we saw a sharp jump in p99 response time for our streaming chat endpoints (SSE + websocket) and an uptick in 5xxs for message streaming. Users on our mobile app reported timeouts and duplicated tokens. This is impacting checkout support flows.

Quick data points from our side:
- p95 ~ 700ms -> 1.8s; p99 jumped to ~6.2s for the /v1/chat/stream route
- Error rate 0.6% -> 4.1% (mostly upstream 502/504)
- Spike correlates with a surge in concurrent streams from a marketing campaign (peak ~25k concurrent)

We opened a vendor ticket but wanted to escalate to your team since this is live customer impact. Can you advise on mitigation steps and ETA?

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. Eng, FastRetail

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 18:37:00 -07:00
Subject: SRE triage: initial findings and temporary mitigations

Marissa / team —

Quick SRE update after initial root-cause triage:
- Spike appears linked to a KV cache eviction storm on a set of older model runner instances (nv4x). High concurrent open streams plus large prompt payloads caused sustained cache churn -> increased GPU kernel setup and queueing.
- Symptoms: token generation stalls, streaming socket backlog, and a downstream HTTP gateway timing out (502).

Actions taken (18:30–18:36):
- Drained 3 affected worker pools and shifted traffic to newer nv5 clusters (18:36).
- Relaxed burst limiter for FastRetail to allow emergency burst capacity for next 30m.
- Applied a short-lived cache-stride policy to reduce KV eviction frequency (in prod control plane).

We uploaded trace bundle and a timeline to the incident channel: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2028-09122
Attaching traces and a cropped p99 timeseries snapshot.

-David
SRE Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Realtime chat errors during tonight's twilight peak — mitigation update

Alex —

Update: after shifting to nv5 pools and applying the cache-stride policy we saw p99 drop from ~6s -> ~900ms within 12 minutes. Error rate dropped back under 0.8%. We are keeping the temporary burst capacity open for another 40 minutes while the campaign tail finishes.

Next steps we are doing now:
- Full backlog drain monitoring for the next 60 minutes with manual intervene points.
- Post-incident follow-up: propose a dedicated routing policy for scheduled marketing blasts (can pre-warm capacity).
- Engineering action: schedule a kernel/caching fix and a gated canary for the older nv4 pools to prevent repeat evictions.

ETA for a write-up and RCA: EOD PST today. If this window clears for you, we’d like to add a short postmortem call Monday to align on mitigations and any credit considerations.

Apologies for the impact — we’ll share the incident notes and the dashboard snapshot shortly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
